newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica doesn't rule out 1 Spanish TV platform.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica doesn't rule out 1 Spanish TV platform.

text.p: Juan Villalonga, the chairman of Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana, said on Thursday that he did not rule out a single digital Television platform in Spain.
Villalonga said he did not rule out an accord with CanalSatelite, now the manager of the sole digital platform in Spain.
Telefonica is due to launch a rival platform later this year
"Canal Plus Francia, Sogecable and Telefonica have a point in common. We want to earn money and if there is the possibility of an accord or an alliance then we will do it," Villalonga said.
Sogecable is 25 percent owned by Promotora de Informaciones SA (Prisa) and 25 percent owned by France's Canal Plus with the remainder in the hands of large banks and large Spanish companies.
Canal Satellite, in which Sogecable participates, launched Spain's first digital TV platform and has offered service since February. Telefonica plans to start its platform later this year.
